title: staged-checkpoint-rollback-and-airgap-image-integrity
author: Priya Rao
description: Context and motivation: On air-gapped and VPC private installs customers observed long, brittle upgrades where partial seed/tenant state could leave the cluster in a non-recoverable state. This PR introduces a lightweight staged rollback checkpoint mechanism plus an image bundle integrity check for airgap installs so the installer can fail fast and offer deterministic rollback checkpoints. Summary of changes: added a checkpoint writer init job and ConfigMap checkpoint store, preflight checksum validation that verifies sha256 entries supplied in values.airgap.imageChecksums, new Helm helper templates for checksum templating and checkpoint annotations, and a new post-rollback hook that attempts staged cleanup and automatic marker reconciliation. The implementation is intentionally opinionated and conservative: checkpoints are opt-in via values.private.checkpoint.enabled=false and limited to the installer lifecycle (pre-install, pre-upgrade, post-rollback). Migration notes and upgrade path: existing clusters are opt-out by default to avoid altering behavior; operators can opt-in on next upgrade. For airgap customers, the new values.airgap.imageChecksums map should be populated (see example in charts/values-airgap.example.yaml) otherwise preflight will warn and skip validation in opt-in mode. Testing: added unit tests for Helm helper functions and an integration scenario exercising a simulated failed post-install to verify the checkpoint rollback path. Safety: checkpoint entries are namespaced with tenant-scoped prefixes; the checkpoint writer uses leader-election to avoid duplicate writes in multi-replica init scenarios. See release_notes for operational steps and troubleshooting tips.

release_notes: Operator-facing: Add values.private.checkpoint.{enabled,ttlDays} to enable staged rollback checkpoints. For air-gapped installs, populate values.airgap.imageChecksums with sha256 digests to enable preflight integrity validation; set values.airgap.failOnMissingChecksums=true to enforce strict validation. This release adds a preflight validation hook and a post-rollback cleanup hook. Backward compatible by default (checkpointing disabled).
upgrade_instructions: 1) Opt-in: set values.private.checkpoint.enabled=true and supply values.airgap.imageChecksums for strict mode. 2) Run helm upgrade --install with --wait so preflight hooks run and validate. 3) If a preflight checksum mismatch occurs, the installer will abort and emit a list of bad images and expected sha256; reconcile bundle and retry. 4) To rollback a failed upgrade the installer will use the last successful checkpoint ConfigMap entry as a reconciliation target.
operational_notes: Checkpoint entries are namespaced by tenant and release. The checkpoint writer acquires a leader-election lock to write exactly-once from concurrent init replicas. The TTL is advisory; operators can prune checkpoints via kubectl patch to the checkpoint ConfigMap or use the provided toolbox script charts/private-installer/scripts/prune-checkpoints.sh.
test_plan: Unit tests for checksum helpers added; integration scenario simulates an interrupted post-install and verifies that post-rollback staged-cleanup hook runs and leaves cluster in a consistent state. Manual verification steps included in site/content/private/airgap-checksum.md.
notes_for_contributors: Avoid introducing non-deterministic ordering inside the checkpoint ConfigMap keys; the Helm templating uses sortedKeys to keep diffs small. Keep the preflight hook cheap — checksum validation only reads the image bundle manifest and verifies sha256 lines, it does not attempt to load images in-cluster.
